Small hoop earrings: slim, polished, warm gold #C9A24B, metal.

Why this outfit works: Your satin halter blouse is the centerpiece. The espresso trousers and camel jacket sit in the same warm family as the beige, and they pair well with your deep skin, dark hair and dark eyes.
